EmailTemplate.subject: We're here for you
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Due to the recent global outbreak of Coronavirus (COVID-19) many industries have been impacted and, unfortunately, the travel sector is no exception.
But rest assured, Flywire is here for you during these unsettling times. As your business navigates the next steps, we've got you covered so you can continue to deliver on your customers' most important payments.
With our global footprint and vertical expertise, we understand the challenges and inconveniences this may bring to your company. Our business continuity plan ensures minimized disruptions in our operations. Additionally, our 24x7 multilingual customer support team is here to help your customers and payers. Your dedicated Client Success Manager is also ready to support in whatever capacity you may need.
We believe in this market and you, our clients.
Together we will overcome this.
Thanks, Colin Smyth Flywire
P.S. We wanted to share this graph from our friends at Skift <[[https://skift.com/]]>. In these uncertain times, it's important to remember the resilience of the travel market.
